description: We are Mars Pathfinder, a passionate engineering and coding team participating in NASA Space Apps Cairo. We are looking for creative minds, developers, and problem-solvers to build innovative space solutions together.
summary: While we focus on physical threats in space, we often overlook a hidden enemy: isolation, which destroys performance and causes depression. Our project, Astro-Guardian, is not just a monitoring system, but a cognitive shield that uses predictive AI to detect cognitive decline before it happens. We provide psychological security through dynamic environmental adaptation by changing lighting, and a virtual companion that simulates Earth communication to break isolation, keeping the subconscious reassured with continuous support. Our proven codebase is the ultimate guarantee for our crew's safety and safe return.
details: Astro-Guardian is an AI-powered cognitive and psychological support shield designed to protect astronauts' mental health during long-duration space missions. It continuously monitors behavioral patterns, stress indicators, and isolation fatigue to provide real-time personalized interventions, ensuring crew resilience and mission safety. We built the system using Python, AI/ML models, and NASA human-factors research data to bridge the critical gap in autonomous deep-space mental healthcare.
dataRefs: NASA Human Research Program (Behavioral Health & Performance)
